=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:whole file (live run_gate at :847; template workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:906, :1004-1005, :1564-1565) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR rewrote the template gate module for P3 (--tests-file / --expect-baseline-fail-file, explicit_tests / expect_baseline_fail, _merge_explicit_tests) but did not update the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (1425 vs 1625 lines), and .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json has no entry for it.
  WHY: tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py::test_live_copies_match_their_templates enforces strict parity when CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA is empty, and the CI prepare step keeps committed hooks/ files (SECURITY_LIVE_PREFIXES), so tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails on head 115737e5 with "Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py", the required lint aggregate fails, and the PR cannot merge. Interactive sessions would also run a stale hook that rejects the new flags. Fix: copy the template byte for byte and keep the executable mode, or run scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py sync. Do not add the path to the divergence list. All four reviewers rated it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:31-59 (vs pagination loop 797-811) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The module docstring's §14 API-budget and log-outcome contract still says "one list read per tick" / "`check` makes 1 list read per tick" (lines 34, 53), and the outcome list (lines 47-48) omits `partial`, but cmd_check now makes up to LIST_MAX_PAGES (5) list reads and logs log("partial", "page_cap"). agents.d/8427-p5-persist-postmerge-verify.md:9 ("Switch off") is also stale.
  WHY: Runtime behaviour is unaffected, but operators get a wrong API budget (up to 5 reads, even with the switch off, because cmd_check pages before the enabled() branch at :816), and "PERSIST postmerge outcome=partial reason=page_cap" matches no documented outcome. All reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:800-811 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a read of pages 2-5 fails, cmd_check reaches the `break` at :806 without logging anything; log("partial", "page_cap") in the for/else runs only when all 5 pages come back full.
  WHY: A transient GitHub error on a later page silently drops the tail of the candidate set from rotate_window for that tick, and nothing records that the listing was cut short. Fix: add log("partial", "gh_read_page") before the break. All reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:572-583, 797-812 (cmd_check rotate_window/check_one at 826-833) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The paginated sort=updated&direction=asc listing can return the same issue on two pages when its updated_at changes between reads, and _candidates() does not de-duplicate by issue number, so check_one() can grade the same issue twice in one tick.
  WHY: check_one() is not idempotent on the recurred path: it posts a duplicate "## Check after merge failed" marker, which replan_count() counts toward PERSIST_MAX_APPROACHES, and appends the number twice to out["replan"], so scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19563-19583 posts two "/answer" retrigger comments. Fix: keep a set of seen numbers in _candidates (about 3 lines). Both reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:797-812 (also 713-715, LIST_MAX_PAGES at 775, rotate_window 778-788) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The listing stops at five 100-issue pages, so when more than 500 ai:verify-pending issues are outstanding, issues beyond the oldest 500 never reach candidate selection, and rotate_window only rotates within the fetched set.
  WHY: Pending issues that return "wait" keep their old updated_at and stay on the oldest pages, so newer issues can pass their 24h window (window_h) and end `unverified` without being graded. Severities disagree: openai_gpt-6-luna rated MAJOR and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated NIT (a documented-bound concern, because oldest-first sorting mitigates realistic backlogs); the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this as not realistic at MAX_PER_TICK=3, noting it logs partial reason=page_cap.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:372-386 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer reports no defect: the new `finally` in _git_head_bytes catches subprocess.TimeoutExpired around proc.wait(timeout=...), and Popen.wait() does not raise ProcessLookupError.
  WHY: The reviewer refutes the pass-1 claim from the code and treats the unclosed proc.stdout as a leak that lasts only until process exit. It reported "No finding" (rated NIT, confidence 1).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: P3 scope of docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md (line 250): "`--tests-file` and `--expect-baseline-fail-file` in the gate module and wrapper (additive)"; the live hook must stay byte-identical to the template with the same executable mode (tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:41-54, scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:117-134)
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (live copy of the gate module; run_gate at :847 and the run subcommand's argument parser)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: PR CHANGED FILES lists workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (8 hunks, ~267 lines) but no .claude/ path, grep over .claude/hooks for "tests-file", "expect-baseline-fail-file", "explicit_tests" and "expect_baseline_fail" returns no match while the template has 14 (_merge_explicit_tests at :906, run_gate params at :1004-1005, argparse options at :1564-1565), the live copy is 1425 lines vs the template's 1625 and its run doc (lines 14-20) lacks both flags, .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json has no entry for the path, and the red tests-hooks-and-orchestrator check on head 115737e5 (test_live_copies_match_their_templates) names this path, with the lint aggregate also red.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (its live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py was not updated):1564-1565 (docstring lines 16-18, run_gate/assertion_diff/main) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The template gate module was rewritten for P3 but not copied over the live .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, and the path is not on the divergence list. CI on head 115737e5 fails with "AssertionError: Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py". The last autofix deferred it as a "sandbox-excluded path".
  WHY: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails, so the required lint aggregate fails and the PR cannot merge. CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA is empty, so strict parity applies, and interactive sessions run a stale hook. Fix: copy byte for byte with the executable mode, or run scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py sync. Do not add the path to the divergence list. The reviewer could not open .claude/, so the CI log is the evidence.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:800-809 (cmd_check) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed read on pages 2-5 `break`s without a log line; the for/else logs `outcome=partial reason=page_cap` only when all 5 pages are full.
  WHY: With more than 100 ai:verify-pending issues and a transient error, newer candidates silently drop out of rotate_window. This is an observability gap only. Fix: log("partial", "gh_read_page").
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:34, 48, 53 (vs loop 800-811) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The helper's §14 batching contract and log-line contract were not updated to the new pagination and `partial` outcome; only the agents.d/8427-p5 fragment was.
  WHY: Behaviour is unaffected, but operators see a wrong API budget, and `PERSIST postmerge outcome=partial` is undocumented.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: P3 "`--tests-file` and `--expect-baseline-fail-file` in the gate module and wrapper (additive)"; the live hook must stay byte-identical. Expected change site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py. Evidence of absence: no .claude/ path in PR CHANGED FILES, and the red tests-hooks-and-orchestrator check names hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py. SEVERITY: BLOCKER. ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Notes, rejected pass-1 items (3 related items): scripts/evidence_broker.py _git_head_bytes kill/wait is not a defect, and the MAJOR rating is unsupported. The P5 TASK_GAP is false: run_persist_postmerge_verify is defined at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 19544 and called at 26283 and 33072. The 500-issue cap is not a realistic failure at MAX_PER_TICK=3 and logs page_cap.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items): scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py _candidates lines 572-583: de-dup by seen numbers (3 lines). cmd_check break at line 806: add log("partial", "gh_read_page") (1 line). scripts/evidence_broker.py _git_head_bytes finally: close proc.stdout to avoid a ResourceWarning (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
